entries.text: DAILY-CHECK 2026-08-03: health 7/7 green, gate 70 live (settingsError null), no halt, A+B bridges reporting, syntax clean, no secrets tracked. SESSION 2026-08-03: THREE COMMITS 5b36001, 6c64458, 9d5301a. Every one is a silent-loss or silent-wrong-number bug; none changed signal generation. (1) 5b36001 tasks/daily/2026-08-02.json was INVALID JSON - a hand-appended entry missing its comma - and daily_notes._load_note swallowed JSONDecodeError and returned an EMPTY note. It feeds a read-modify-write (log_entry, auto_log), so the next `daily_notes.py log` would have saved that empty note over the file and erased the entire 08-02 session record. Backed up first, comma restored, both entries intact at 7542 bytes. Parse failure now exits loud and leaves the file byte-identical - verified on a deliberately corrupt fixture. Two more silent failures in the same file: auto_log tested isinstance(trades, list) but /api/journal answers {"journal":[...]}, and filtered on `opened_at` where the journal carries `openTime` - NO TRADE HAS EVER REACHED A DAILY NOTE. _save_note now writes temp+rename. (2) 6c64458 /api/trade-opened copied sig.rr - the SIGNAL's planned R:R - into the journal row beside entry/sl/tp taken from the BROKER's fill. The two described different trades: the only real trade stored rr 2.5 while its own prices imply 6.57, and it closed at exactly its stop for -1.00R. That is the mechanism behind the rr-artifact inflation - /api/stats/by-setup averaged the stored field and reported avgRR +2.5 on a 0% win rate. rr is now derived from the row's own prices, plannedRr preserves the signal's intent, and by-setup derives from prices so rows written earlier are corrected ON READ - journal history is read, never rewritten. Endpoint now returns avgRR 6.6 / avgRealizedR -1.00 for BB_SQUEEZE_WATCH. (3) 9d5301a saveLearning ended in `catch (e) {}` - a locked or unwritable learning.json discarded every recorded outcome with nothing in the log. Both saveJournal and saveLearning also wrote in place, so a crash mid-write truncates the one file CLAUDE.md marks irreplaceable. Both now temp+rename via writeJsonAtomic, traced against overwrite / create / unwritable-path. learning.json verified byte-identical across two restarts except sessionCount 78->79. TWO TRAPS HIT AND SOLVED, BOTH WORTH REMEMBERING. (1) I CAUSED ONE: `git add -A` in the session-log commit newly tracked server/strategy_settings.json AND server/journal.json - neither was tracked at 4b5eb07. strategy_settings.json is per-machine EXACTLY so a shared commit cannot push one box's fixedLotSize onto the other, which is the failure that reset VPS sizing on 2026-08-02. Caught it by diffing the commit before deploying, not after. Fixed in e093ea8: both untracked via `git rm --cached` and added to .gitignore, working copies intact. Local strategy_settings verified still gate 70 / fixedLot 0.01. NEVER USE `git add -A` IN THIS REPO. (2) THE PULL ABORTS TWICE unless the order is right: git refuses on locally-modified tracked files (server/learning.json, tasks/jarvis_memory.json) AND on untracked files it would overwrite (tasks/daily/2026-08-01.json, 2026-08-02.json, both trivial auto-generated PLAN notes on the VPS). Correct order is: back up -> move untracked blockers aside to .vpslocal (never delete) -> `git checkout --` the conflicting tracked files -> pull -> restore live state from backup -> verify hashes. Restoring BEFORE the pull re-dirties the files and the pull aborts again - my first attempt did exactly that and HEAD silently stayed at c8c3d82 while the log said 'Updating c8c3d82..e093ea8'. ALWAYS CONFIRM HEAD MOVED; the Updating line prints even when the pull aborts. (3) The db is held open by the running server, so Get-FileHash fails - read it with [System.IO.File]::Open($p,'Open','Read','ReadWrite'). (4) VPS server restarts cleanly via Stop-ScheduledTask/Start-ScheduledTask SmartEntryServer; bridges are untouched by that. DIVERGENCE NOTED, NOT CHANGED: VPS maxTradesPerDay=10, local=5. Same gate (70) and same fixedLotSize (0.01), but the two boxes have different daily trade caps. Per-machine file, so this is legal - flagging it because it is invisible from git and neither note recorded it before.

CORRECTION to this session's earlier note: I was WRONG that SmartEntryVPSBackupPull had not run since 01/08 and that the off-box backup was two days stale. I read the task's LastRunTime at 03:47; it fired on schedule at 04:00 the SAME MORNING and pulled backup_20260803_030003.zip (1,745,475 bytes, 315 files) into vps-backups\. The one REAL and minor behaviour: the pull only happens when this laptop is awake at 04:00 - pull_log.txt shows 26/07, 28/07 and 03/08 with nothing between. ONE --AUTO BRIDGE PER ACCOUNT - SHIPPED AND LIVE ON BOTH BOXES (3580684, 4de01cd). MEASURED FIRST, AND THE BOARD OVERSTATED IT: both bridges read mt5.positions_get(), which is the BROKER's view of the shared account, not their own server's - so maxConcurrentPositions=3 and sizing.js:207's symbol+direction duplicate guard DID both work across the two boxes. The real exposure was a RACE: the window between reading positions and placing the order spans an Opus approval call with a 25s timeout, and the two bridges poll on unsynchronised 60s cycles, so roughly 1 signal in 6 could double-fill - not every one. What was genuinely unprotected: circuit breakers did NOT combine (3 consecutive losses each = six on that account before both halted), daily caps did NOT combine (local 5 + VPS 10 = up to 15/day), and the trade record was SPLIT across two journals so neither box held the full history of 11581419 - which directly undercuts the reason the current config is being run at all. FIX: local Bridge B stopped; the fleet is now local A=25446287, VPS A=11581419, one --auto bridge per account. tasks/ensure_running.ps1 and tasks/watchdog.bat now take their bridge list from MT5_EXPECTED_ACCOUNTS in keys.env (the same variable the healer reads), so what we start, what we restart and what we alarm about cannot disagree. Both fall back to A,B on a missing file, missing variable, empty value or parse error - never to an empty list, which would start no bridges at all. All five failure modes traced before anything was stopped. TWO BUGS CAUGHT IN MY OWN CODE BEFORE THEY WENT LIVE. (1) findstr WITHOUT /c: SPLITS THE PATTERN ON SPACES and searches each piece separately, so '[ ]*=' matched any line containing '=' - a keys.env holding FOO=bar set EXPECTED_TAGS to 'bar' and Bridge B would have been restarted anyway. Fixed with /c: and re-traced. (2) I filtered processes by CommandLine LIKE '*start_bridge_B.bat*' and my OWN PowerShell process matched, because the filter string appears in the script text - it stopped Bridge B correctly and then killed its own shell. Never match a process by a substring the matching script itself contains. THE BIG ONE - keys.env WAS PARSED BUT NEVER REACHED process.env, SO IT CONFIGURED NOTHING (4de01cd). readKeysEnv() has always read the file; nothing ever copied the result into process.env, so every process.env.X lookup in server/index.js used its default regardless of what keys.env said. Symptom that exposed it: keys.env carried MT5_EXPECTED_ACCOUNTS=A and the healer kept reporting '1/2 expected - B has never connected' on a machine that now deliberately owns one bridge. PLACEMENT IS THE WHOLE FIX: a loader lower in the file was STILL too late, because autohealer.js:33 captures EXPECTED_MT5_ACCOUNTS at MODULE-LOAD time, so anything after require('./autohealer') never sees it. The loader now runs above the local requires. Real env vars still win (only unset keys are filled), empty values are skipped, unreadable file logs and continues on defaults. Verified expected count 2 -> 1 across a restart with no other change. AUDITED BEFORE DEPLOYING THIS TO THE VPS: the VPS keys.env additionally holds TELEGRAM_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, so the loader could have newly switched on Telegram polling there. Checked the VPS server log first - 3700 of the last 4000 lines are 'status code 409', i.e. it is ALREADY polling, so those keys are already in that process's environment and the loader is a no-op for them. Deployed only after confirming that. VPS signals read src=yahoo immediately after its restart - expected, and handled: the server recomputes on the yahoo->mt5 transition and the bridge refuses to trade a yahoo-stamped signal for a symbol it has pushed bars for. AI PIPELINE FIXED AND PROVEN - FIRST REAL ANALYSIS OUTPUT THIS SYSTEM HAS EVER PRODUCED (9739d2c, dd823f7). ROOT CAUSE, found by elimination after two wrong hypotheses of mine: cmd.exe TRUNCATED EVERY AGENT PROMPT AT THE FIRST NEWLINE. find_claude() resolves to claude.CMD; subprocess.run executes a .CMD through cmd.exe, which re-parses argv and treats a newline as a command separator. Proved with a 3-marker probe: the agent received LINE_ONE_MARKER and nothing else. The analyst briefs put OUTPUT_FILE and the FACTS path after blank lines, so every analyst got only line one of its brief - knew the topic, never learned where the data was or where to write, replied 'I don't have the data, could you paste it?', which the harness logged as 'no JSON object in response'. Same for the synthesiser and for /engineer --plan, which only ever received 'You are a senior engineer and architect.' FIX: prompts go in on stdin, which cmd.exe cannot re-parse. WRONG HYPOTHESES I RULED OUT ON THE WAY (all measured, not guessed): add_dirs/--add-dir (landed 4b5eb07, real but incidental - probe read an 883KB file fine); prompt size (only ~2200 chars); the appended system prompt (probe passed with it); 5-way concurrency (5 parallel probes all returned DONE). What isolated it was that identical invocations from git bash worked while the module's failed - bash resolves 'claude' to a shim that does not go through cmd.exe. RESULT: all 5 analysts wrote real reports (9-13KB each) plus a 42KB synthesis; reports file 55,969 bytes vs 5,753 bytes of pure _error before; pipeline exit 0 vs exit 2. WHAT THE ANALYSIS ACTUALLY SAYS over 2381 replayed trades 2021-09..2026-07: the system is NOT broken, it is UN-GATED and has no edge net of its own cost assumption - overall expectancyR 0.036 against costAssumptionR 0.05. ONE condition accounts for the entire deficit and more: entry RSI below 50 covers 459 closed trades worth -78.4R, while the remaining 1796 make +159.9R at PF 1.22, expectancyR 0.089 - and it improves ALL FOUR time quartiles (0.010->0.064, 0.017->0.041, 0.080->0.166, 0.038->0.085), so it is not a window artefact. The synthesiser found what none of the five analysts did: the per-setup regime gates three of them ranked #1 are STRICT SUBSETS of the RSI rule (all 90 RANGE_TRADE_LONG, all 130 BUY_OVERSOLD, all 227 STRONG DOWNTREND trades sit inside RSI<50), so they are redundant, not additive; and SQUEEZE_BREAKOUT, scored healthy at +24.18R, is TWO populations - +58.5R PF 1.65 above RSI 50 and -34.3R PF 0.87 below it. Only genuinely independent leak: SPX on H4, still -47.6R after the RSI gate, negative in all four quartiles, driven by SPX|MOMENTUM|H4 -39.2R over 378 trades while the SAME setup earns +101.1R on Gold and +42.9R on BTC. It also flags that the one auto-tunable lever (adxTrendingMin) can now only do harm: after the RSI gate the sub-threshold bucket is PROFITABLE (adx<20: 682 trades, PF 1.10, +11.4R). NOTHING IMPLEMENTED - all of this is signal generation and needs Themis's explicit approval per CLAUDE.md. LAPTOP AUTOMATION FIXED TOO: auto_daily.bat, morning_agent.bat and auto_weekly.bat all ran claude from INSIDE the project, so it booted as JARVIS and obeyed 'one question at a time - then stop'. Proof from the logs: the morning agent's entire output on 25/07 was 'Want me to build those two endpoints now?' and morning_summary.txt was never written; the only weekly report ever produced is 75 bytes containing nothing but the two header lines the script echoed. All three now run from a clean room with --add-dir and a non-interactive system prompt. Also fixed in them: gate hardcoded 65 vs live 70 (now read from /api/strategy-settings); msg.exe was the last command so it set the exit code, which is the FAILED(1) on the weekly task, not the analysis; morning_agent told an unattended agent to EDIT server/index.js AND COMMIT every morning - now it writes a proposal instead; a bare '65%' was itself a .bat escaping bug. VERIFIED LIVE: auto_daily.bat exit 0 with a full real report reading the live gate 70. CORRECTIONS TO MY OWN EARLIER CLAIMS THIS SESSION: SmartEntryPro is NOT blocked (ran 04:48 today, result 0); Daily Check and Morning Agent are NOT broken (their REFUSED codes were stale from 01/08, flags already clear, both scheduled to run today). Daily Check DID have a real fault - a WEEKLY trigger despite its name - now changed to daily, next run 07:30. MIN-ENTRY-RSI GATE BUILT, SHIPPED OFF, WALK-FORWARD RUNNING (f2d094c, 6508124). WHAT SHIPPED: minEntryRsi added to STRATEGY_LIMITS (min 0, max 60, DEFAULT 0 = OFF) and gated inside generateSignal at index.js, after the setups resolve and BEFORE any confidence scoring, so it can only ever remove an entry - never create or promote one. Applies to BOTH directions because the measured population is 'entries below RSI N', not 'longs below RSI N'. It reads from strategySettings rather than a constant so the harness can vary it, and is deliberately NOT pinned to any other setting - the same trap that would have made GOLD_SQUEEZE_MODERATE_CONFIDENCE dead code when the gate moved. Load/save/clamp and /api/strategy-settings pick it up free because they iterate Object.keys(STRATEGY_LIMITS). VERIFIED LIVE ON BOTH BOXES: minEntryRsi=0. WHY A NEW HARNESS: tasks/rsi_walkforward.cjs cannot reuse mtf_walkforward's trick of replaying once and filtering the trade list. That is valid for the confidence gate, which only DELETES rows. minEntryRsi runs inside generateSignal, so it fires on the daily AND the 4H signal independently - raising it changes which multi-timeframe COMBINATIONS form at all: a suppressed daily signal turns an agreeing pair into an H4-only entry with different levels and a different confidence. So every candidate gets its own full replay (5 values x 3 assets = 15). Two design choices: scored at the LIVE gate 70 rather than at the exposure floor, because that is the population that actually trades; and fold boundaries are taken from the BASELINE run and reused for every candidate, because folding each candidate's own list separately moves the cut dates and makes the columns incomparable. It also reports tradesGivenUpVsBaseline - a floor that wins on expectancy while halving the sample buys a thinner, slower system, which is a real cost on a system already starved of closed trades. SMOKE TEST: Gold 265 trades at minEntryRsi=0, 226 at 50 - the setting reaches the engine through the sandbox. START.bat WOULD HAVE UNDONE TONIGHT'S BRIDGE FIX (6508124). It started bridges A and B unconditionally, so the next logon would have put a second --auto bridge back on 11581419 - the account the VPS already trades - each with its own circuit breaker. It now reads MT5_EXPECTED_ACCOUNTS from keys.env like the healer, ensure_running.ps1 and watchdog.bat, falling back to A,B and never to an empty list. Traced across A / A,B / B / no-variable. CORRECTION IN THE USER'S FAVOUR - THE ELEVATED SHELL IS NOT NEEDED. I had been handing back 'clear SmartEntryPro's battery flags' as a required manual step. Compared what START.bat provides against ensure_running.ps1: ensure_running covers every HEADLESS component - MT5 terminals, server, bridges, watchdog guardian, VPS tunnel - has its battery flags already clear, and runs every 10 minutes plus on session unlock. START.bat only adds a browser tab and an interactive claude window on top. So SmartEntryPro being battery-blocked costs nothing operationally; the elevated fix is cosmetic, not required. BOTH BOXES ON 6508124. VPS verified: gate 70, fixedLot 0.01, minEntryRsi 0, settingsError null, all 5 protected files SHA-256 UNCHANGED, backup C:ps-state-backup-20260803-061215. NOT DECIDED YET: whether to turn minEntryRsi on and at what value. Waiting on the walk-forward. The synthesis itself flagged that every figure in it is PRE-confidence-filter and that replay has never been calibrated against live fills, so the honest sequence is folds first, decision second.

THE FACT PACK NOW MEASURES THE LIVE PATH (1eb5e16, 5f9fd36). THIS INVALIDATES MOST OF TONIGHT'S EARLIER ANALYSIS NUMBERS AND THAT IS THE POINT. parallel_analysis.py fed the five analysts from tasks/_replay_engine.cjs - single-timeframe generateSignal - while production runs generateSignalMTF. Every finding they have ever produced described a population the live gate cannot take, and the pack carried NO per-trade confidence at all. The synthesiser was right to list both as blind spots in its own output. SHIPPED: (1) _replay_mtf.cjs now records entry RSI (rsiDaily, rsiH4, and `rsi` resolved to the timeframe that produced the entry) plus regime, trend, adx, bandwidth and volRatio - the remaining dimensions the fact pack groups by, without which it could not move to the live path without silently losing those axes. Fields resolve via pickTf on the same principle entry/stop/target already follow: on an H4_ONLY cohort the daily signal is WAIT by definition so its indicators describe a signal never taken. regime was the exception - it is computed in generateSignalMTF, not per timeframe - and routing it through pickTf returned null on every row; caught by ASSERTING the populated count rather than assuming, the same class of check that would have caught the 18% Gold gap months earlier. All ten dimensions verified 226/226. (2) parallel_analysis.py now replays the live path, 3 assets D1+H4+H1 each, at REPLAY_CONF_FLOOR 40 so sub-gate cohorts stay visible with every trade labelled by confidence. byTimeframe REPLACED by byCohort (meaningless now that the path always reads all three timeframes; the real question is which COMBINATION fired) and byConfidence ADDED with bands straddling the live gate. TWO FINDINGS THAT WERE STRUCTURALLY INVISIBLE BEFORE. (a) THE GATE AT 70 IS INDEPENDENTLY VINDICATED - the sign changes exactly at the cut: conf<50 220 closed PF 0.76 -39.2R | conf50-64 195 PF 1.06 +8.2R | conf65-69 52 PF 0.91 -3.2R | conf70-79 111 PF 1.35 +24.4R | conf>=80 33 PF 1.66 +13.9R. (b) DAILY_ONLY_H4_NEUTRAL IS A -41.2R HOLE over 113 closed at PF 0.56, almost the mirror image of H4_ONLY at +44.8R over 478. Nearly all the book's profit comes from H4-only entries and an equal amount is handed straight back by daily-only entries where H4 is neutral. This is a bigger and cleaner target than the RSI gate. TWO CAVEATS THAT CUT AGAINST MY OWN EARLIER WORK. (i) The MTF path is MUCH weaker than the single-TF pack implied: 722 trades, PF 1.01, +4.12R, expectancy 0.007, versus the old pack's 2381 trades and +81.54R. Last night's headline numbers were inflated by measuring the wrong function. (ii) rsi>=65 is NEGATIVE on the live path (286 closed, PF 0.88, -24.77R) while the single-TF pack called it the best bucket (+93.81R, PF 1.14). Direct contradiction between paths. minEntryRsi=50 still looks right - sub-50 was negative on BOTH paths, and the rsi_walkforward that justified it already used the MTF replay - but the 'higher RSI is better' half of that story does not survive. OBSERVABILITY COST TO REMEMBER: the pack inherits live settings, so with minEntryRsi=50 active it can no longer show what sub-50 entries WOULD have done - the very evidence that justified the setting. liveState.strategySettings records the value so analysts can see why the bucket is missing, but any future review of that decision must re-run with MTF_MIN_ENTRY_RSI=0. ALSO CORRECTED: two stale comment blocks in parallel_analysis.py - the usage examples still advertised --tf D1, and a block above AGENT_CWD still asserted 'Analysts run INSIDE the project', which is the exact arrangement that made every analyst run fail. VPS DEPLOY TRAP HIT AGAIN AND IT IS THE SAME ONE: `git pull` printed 'Updating 6508124..5f9fd36' AND ABORTED, HEAD staying at 6508124. Blocker was tasks/daily/2026-08-03.json, which the VPS had written its own 7 entries into. Preserved as .vpslocal, then pulled. ALWAYS CONFIRM HEAD MOVED. Both boxes now on 5f9fd36; VPS protected files all SHA-256 UNCHANGED, minEntryRsi 50 on disk, D1+H4+H1 history confirmed present for all three symbols (the MTF replay needs H1, which the old single-TF pack never read). ANALYSTS COMPLETED ON THE CORRECTED MTF PACK - 5/5 OK, first time they have ever seen the real path AND finished (b743e36). THE RUN BEFORE THIS ONE DIED ON BILLING, NOT CODE. All five analysts and both synthesiser attempts failed in 5-9 seconds with 'Credit balance is too low'. ROOT CAUSE: every nested claude CLI call inherited ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the environment, and when that is set the CLI IGNORES the claude.ai subscription and bills pay-as-you-go API credit. The CLI has been printing the warning on every single run all along: 'claude.ai connectors are disabled because ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or another auth source is set and takes precedence over your claude.ai login'. parallel_agents.py's own docstring has always claimed 'Uses your existing Claude Pro subscription - no API key needed'; the leaked variable had been quietly breaking that promise. Verified both directions before changing anything: key set -> credit error, key unset -> normal reply. FIXED in four places: agent_env() strips it for run_agent AND the --plan planner (which previously passed no env at all), and auto_daily.bat / morning_agent.bat / auto_weekly.bat clear it inside setlocal. server/index.js keeps its own key for the SDK calls it makes directly - separate billing route, untouched. SMARTENTRY_AGENT_USE_API_KEY=1 restores the old behaviour deliberately. auto_daily.bat verified exit 0 with a full report afterwards. WHAT THE ANALYSTS FOUND ON THE LIVE PATH (all five independent, then synthesised): (1) BB_SQUEEZE_WATCH is the ONLY setup with a real well-sampled edge - expectancyR +0.222 over 213 closed. Ranked #1: weight toward it, extra weight when regime is SQUEEZE. (2) DAILY_ONLY_H4_NEUTRAL should be suppressed or require materially higher confidence - INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION of the -41.2R / PF 0.56 hole I found in the byCohort axis hours earlier. Two separate methods, same conclusion. (3) MOMENTUM gated out of TRENDING - and 100% of its trades occur in TRENDING, so in practice that is a disable. regime-fit: the TRENDING regime loses -10.05R over 418 closed almost entirely because of MOMENTUM (-23.7R). (4) Disable TREND_FOLLOW. (5) risk-and-config INDEPENDENTLY FLAGGED THE LIVE BRIDGE PROBLEM from the fact pack alone: the mt5Bridge healer check reports ok:true while its own detail line says an undeclared account 'B' is reporting. That is the elevated duplicate Bridge B that SmartEntryPro's old START.bat resurrected at 04:48 and which I cannot stop without an admin shell. An analyst reading liveState caught a real operational fault - exactly what this pipeline was built for. (6) strength-gate: MODERATE's blended near-breakeven (expectancyR 0.003 over 606 closed) HIDES that BB_SQUEEZE_WATCH alone contributes +47.21R at MODERATE while MOMENTUM, TREND_FOLLOW, RANGE_TRADE_SHORT and SQUEEZE_BREAKOUT combine for -42.71R at the same strength. Proposes replacing the single global minStrength with a per-setup enable/strength floor - one mechanism that implements several of the other actions. (7) The learning engine is confirmed broken from the data side: 84 sessions and 611 closed trades exist, yet learning.setupStats holds ONE key (BB_SQUEEZE_WATCH, 1 loss) - 6 of 7 setups record nothing, while the learningFile healer check reports ok:true.
